project_type: Expo React Native app (rewrite from native Android Kotlin/Jetpack Compose)
build_system: Expo CLI with npm/yarn - greenfield Expo SDK 51 project
test_framework: None initially - focus on creating working app
build_command: npx expo export --platform web (for validation without device)
verification_instructions: 1. Check TypeScript compiles without errors (npx tsc --noEmit). 2. Verify project structure matches Expo conventions. 3. Ensure package.json has all needed dependencies.
setup_instructions: User will run: npm install && npx expo start on their machine
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode - cannot run npm install, npx expo start, or any network-dependent commands. Create all source files with correct package.json so the user can run npm install on their machine. Validate by reading files and checking TypeScript syntax manually.
contribution_requirements: README.md must be in Uzbek language. All UI text in Uzbek. Arabic text for Quran/Tajweed content.
key_patterns: expo-router for file-based routing (app/ directory), AsyncStorage for persistence, expo-av for audio recording, React Context for state management, TypeScript interfaces for data models
relevant_files: app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/data/local/TajweedData.kt - 12 tajweed rules with Arabic examples and Uzbek descriptions
app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/data/local/QuranData.kt - 7 surahs with ayahs, translations, page numbers
app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/data/model/ - TajweedRule, QuranAyah, UserProgress, RecordingResult, PracticeSession models
app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/ui/theme/Color.kt - Islamic green/gold color palette and tajweed rule colors
directory_structure: Will create standard Expo project: app/ (expo-router pages), src/data/ (models and static data), src/services/ (API, storage), src/contexts/ (React contexts), src/components/ (reusable UI), src/constants/ (colors, theme), assets/
